shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.intro: Every order is cut by hand in our Riffa shop, then packed flat and sent on its way — or kept ready for you to collect.

sections.p: Orders paid before 4 pm (Bahrain time) are usually cut the same day and dispatched the next working day. Large wholesale orders may take a little longer — we'll message you if so.
Choose “Pickup” at checkout and we'll message you on WhatsApp when your fabric is ready at our shop in Hunainiya, Riffa. Pickup is always free.
Prices are charged in Bahraini dinars. Customs duties or import taxes in your country, if any, are paid by the receiver on delivery.
You can follow your order any time on the Track order page using your order number and phone number.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.intro: Because every length is cut to order, we can't take back fabric once it's cut. But if something isn't right, we'll make it right.

sections.p: If your fabric arrives damaged, has a weaving fault, or isn't what you ordered, message us within 3 days of delivery with a photo. We'll send a replacement or refund you in full, including delivery.
We measure twice and cut once. If your length is short of what you paid for, tell us within 3 days and we'll refund the difference or send the missing length.
Cut fabric can't be returned for a change of mind or colour. Not sure about a shade? Message us before you order — we're happy to send close-up photos or a video in daylight.
You can cancel for a full refund any time before your fabric is cut. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number.
Refunds go back to the card or BenefitPay account you paid with, usually within 5–10 working days depending on your bank.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.intro: The things customers ask us most. Don't see yours? Just message us.

items.q: How much fabric do I need?
items.a: It depends on the garment and your size. As a guide, an abaya takes about 3–3.5 m and a thobe about 3.5–4 m. Use the metre calculator on our home page, or ask your tailor.

items.q: What's the smallest amount I can order?
items.a: Most fabrics can be ordered from half a metre, in half-metre steps. Each fabric page shows its minimum.
Yes. For bulk quantities, message us on WhatsApp with the fabrics and lengths you need and we'll send a quote.

items.q: Will the colour look the same as on screen?
items.a: We photograph every fabric in daylight, but screens vary. If the exact shade matters, ask us for an extra photo or video before ordering.
Online with BenefitPay or any debit or credit card. Payment is taken securely by Tap Payments — we never see your card details.

items.q: Can I see prices in my currency?
items.a: Yes — use the currency switcher at the top of the page. Prices shown in other currencies are estimates; you're always charged in Bahraini dinars.
Of course. We're in Hunainiya, Riffa — you'll find the map at the bottom of our home page. You're welcome to see and feel the fabrics before you buy.
We sell fabric only, cut to your length. We don't offer tailoring or ready-made garments.
